svg.title: Monthly contributions — an ink mountain landscape
svg.desc: 1,945 GitHub profile contributions across 263 active days, from 2025-11-09 to 2026-11-13. Main mountain height grows with squared monthly contributions. Each month, count, and daily calendar travels with its mountain. The counter below sums contributions in this displayed calendar window. Taller peaks gather irregular snowcaps, and drifting foreground wisps cross their upper slopes. Fainter cragged peaks use the same drawing at different depths. Birds flap in front of and behind the main peaks. Snow, clouds, brushwork trees, mist, reflections and river life are decorative. A fish jumps at a different spot every 3 seconds; its ripples drift with the river. The seamless scene repeats every 180 seconds. Reduced motion is supported.

g.aria-label: 1,945 total contributions in the displayed calendar window
